title: Graduate Civil Engineer
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (advert 95143709); no link out and no applications email published by the employer.
rationale: Graduate role asking for a Civil Engineering Bachelor degree, AutoCAD and Revit and a Class C licence; Marc holds a BSCE, studied AutoCAD and Revit, and has an Australian licence.
Stormwater focus (detention, infiltration, drainage) links to his Advanced Diploma stormwater drainage design.
Producing AutoCAD drawings, maintaining a drawing library and product proposals for councils suits his drafting and documentation strengths.
caution: Perth based, so relocation would be needed. Bachelor degree is from 2019 (Philippines); the SEEK question on years as a civil engineer should be answered honestly (about one year of site work in 2019 to 2020). Has not worked on water or wastewater projects; SolidWorks is not on record.
gaps: No water or wastewater project experience
employer_line: GRAF Australia manufactures rotomoulded products in Western Australia and supplies German engineered rainwater, stormwater detention, wastewater and grease trap systems for Australian sites.
